items.title: ELPIS II: stem cell therapy laromestrocel misses RVEF endpoint in HLHS infants but shows fewer major cardiac events (company update, AHA 2026 late-breaker)
items.summary: In the 40-infant phase 2b ELPIS II trial, laromestrocel injected during Stage II palliation for hypoplastic left heart syndrome did not improve 12-month RVEF, but the company reports fewer MACE (1 vs 8, P=0.043); full data are due at AHA 2026 on Nov 8 (Longeveron press release, Oct 26, 2026).
bullets: **ELPIS II** (company update, Oct 26 2026): phase 2b, randomised, double-blind trial of **laromestrocel** (allogeneic mesenchymal stem cells) in **hypoplastic left heart syndrome (HLHS)**.
**40 infants** got a **single intramyocardial dose during Stage 2 palliation** (Glenn / hemi-Fontan) or surgery alone; **12-month** follow-up.
**Primary endpoint missed**: change in **RVEF** at month 12; **-2.6 vs -3.3 points**, adjusted difference **-1.36** (95% CI -8.0 to 6.7; **p=0.68**; CMR in 28 infants).
**MACE** (secondary): **8 standard care vs 1 laromestrocel** (p=0.043). **Total major cardiac events**: **22 vs 3** (rate ratio 0.16, p<0.001).
**Tricuspid regurgitation events or valve surgery**: **5 vs 0** (p=0.066, not significant). **One death and one VAD** were in the standard-care arm.
Company reports **no treatment-related serious adverse events** through 12 months; full data at **AHA 2026** (Nov).

Caveat: **company-reported**, not peer reviewed. Primary endpoint missed; numbers tiny (MACE 1 vs 8); **MACE is not defined in the release** and no multiplicity adjustment is reported, so secondary findings are **hypothesis-generating**.
items.source: Longeveron Inc. press release (investor site), Oct 26, 2026; ELPIS II, NCT04925024
